subject: ist-f
title: (R)IST.F.------MT.INFO.
description: Diagram in NYM-26, paired with v1-p392-1. (R)IST-F — the reality of isolated focus — is crossed with MT-INFO (multi-information). Besides the main line to MT-INFO, two lines leave the subject. One runs to CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis), from which branch INFO-F (information focus) and DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) → MTH (methodology) → P-FC (particular focus). The other runs to INTL (intellectualism), from which branch CR-INFO-DY (circular information dynamics) and IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment).
